project.title: Metagenomic study of the microbial genes abundance in treated palm oil mill effluent
project.description: Palm oil mill effluent contains high amount of organic compounds which will be detrimental to the environment if released untreated. In this study, we aim to study and elucidate the microbial genes abundance in the palm oil mill effluent that is undergoing anaerobic digestion.

samples: Non-tumor DNA sample from blood of a human male participant in the dbGaP study "NINDS Stroke Genetics Network (SiGN)"
